{{Top}}
{{Quote|So exactly what is it that you want?''"<br />"''Answers.''"<br />"''Those can be hard to come by. Unlike questions, which are about as plentiful as hydrogen atoms in the universe.|[[Kuat (person)|Kuat of Kuat]] and [[Kodir of Kuhlvult]]|<ref name="Slave Ship">''[[Slave Ship]]''</ref>}}
'''Hydrogen''' was an element that formed the base material for nearly all [[Star/Legends|stars]] within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Hydrogen was the lightest chemical element known to the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]].<ref name="Pandemonium">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium]]''</ref> Hydrogen and another element called [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] formed a substance called [[Water/Legends|water]] when chemically combined. When a star ceased burning its hydrogen supply into [[Helium/Legends|helium]], it would then begin to burn heavier elements before ending in a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] or diminishing into a [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]]. According to [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], it was one of the most common things in existence, followed closely by stupidity and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] ball cockpits.
